bio.text: Julie Mayberry is serving her fifth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 92, which includes all of Grant County and a portion of Saline County.
She works in media and advertising for Spirit Publications, Inc., and lives in Hensley.
She graduated from Emerson College with a Bachelor of Science degree in mass communications and broadcast journalism.
